concept: VPC endpoints: Gateway endpoint for S3 instead of NAT
tests: Choosing the cheapest way to send heavy traffic from a private subnet to S3, bypassing the NAT Gateway.
expected: A Gateway VPC endpoint for S3 — free, adds a prefix-list route to the route table, eliminates NAT data processing charges. Triggers: "heavy data transfers to S3", "minimize cost", "avoid NAT Gateway".
why_not: An Interface endpoint for S3 exists but is billed hourly and per GB; a second NAT Gateway increases cost; peering to an "AWS S3 VPC" is not possible.
